benchmark.candidate: independent parameters and optimizer restored to original tier step 1000 before every condition
benchmark.training_boundary: full microbatch; microbatch 8 includes optimizer update
benchmark.arrival_process: fixed seeded exponential intervals, rescaled to target mean; identical across tiers, modes, repeats
benchmark.requests: max(300, ceil(rate * 20 * slowest measured training step seconds / (1-load_fraction))) fixed from exclusive calibration before interference results
benchmark.host_quiet_check: repeats 2 and 3 wait for both short L1 runs; evaluation uses disjoint CPU cores
benchmark.timeout: 30 seconds recorded as deadline exceeded, requests still completed; hard drain limit recorded if unfinished
benchmark.latency: scheduled arrival to CPU-readable action completion, includes queueing; no device-wide sync in serving
benchmark.training_throughput: 8 times completed optimizer steps wholly within workload measurement interval / interval seconds
benchmark.cuda_timing: per-request CUDA events; microbatch completion event for legal yield boundary
